intro: Reference: tap any button, knob or key to read what it does. A button that opens a page changes the knob labels here to that page's. Switch to Play or Guide to use the panel. On the FM-1 itself, holding GLO shows a guide like this on its own screen.
master: Output volume. MASTER is always the volume, whatever the other knobs are doing.
screen: The screen shows the rings as concentric circles, the oldest innermost, each one its own recording; the selected ring is the bright one, and grains ride the ring they play. MORPH is the small square in the middle. The top line names the page, the keys' job and the selected ring; under the rings are the SOURCE that REC would capture and REC's state, or DRIFT's countdown to the next generation; the boxes at the foot name what each knob sets now.
keys: With no ring yet, a key strikes MORPH and the note is caught as the first ring. After that each key latches a pitch for the grains, up to four; the grains take them in turn. The key the seed was struck with plays the ring as recorded. A new key also plays its grains at once, even with PLAY off.
select: Selects the ring that SILT plays and the knobs edit, on every page. Each ring keeps its own settings; selecting never changes a recording.

KNOB1: Pick the grain playback position on the selected ring. Each recording has an independent playhead.
KNOB4: 0 plays only the selected recording; raise to bring in grain streams from the other rings. Each ring remembers its own position, speed, grain controls and mode.
ALGORITHM: Four playback personalities: LOOP follows the source, CLOUD layers grains, PULSE fires discrete hits, FRACTURE makes abrupt position, pitch and direction jumps.
PRESETS: Shifts every grain, 24 semitones down to 24 up, on top of the held keys.

morph.title: MORPH SOURCE
keys: On MORPH's page each key strikes a synth note, up to four at once. A note dies away by itself (DECAY, on MIX, says how long); with DECAY at the top it holds until its key is tapped again. A note is richest and brightest as it is struck, and plainer as it dies away.

KNOB1: Moves the sound left and right across the square, between its corners' ways of making sound.
KNOB2: Moves the sound up and down the square.
KNOB3: Harmonic richness of each corner's sound.
ALGORITHM: Carries the sound round a circle in the square by itself.
PRESETS: How long the struck MODAL corner rings.

KNOB1: How much of the selected ring is copied under the next capture. At 0 a capture is the source alone.
KNOB4: Turn right once to arm deleting the selected ring, twice to arm clearing everything. SEL confirms; any other button calls it off.
KNOB2: Turn right to protect the selected ring from replacement by REC; turn left to unlock. Deleting a locked ring is still possible only through the explicit confirmation.

KNOB1: Each grain's envelope: 0 struck (fast attack), 50 a bell, 100 a slow swell.
KNOB2: Random grain length, up to a quarter to four times SIZE.
KNOB3: The chance a grain jumps an octave; higher adds fifths and two octaves.
KNOB4: Each grain slightly off pitch, up to 50 cents either way.
ALGORITHM: 1 to 4 grains started together, each on the next held key: low values play the keys in turn, high values as a chord.
PRESETS: The chance a grain plays backward.

KNOB1: Moves POSITION back and forth by itself.
KNOB2: When grains start: an even pulse at 0, irregular at 100.
KNOB3: The play point going round the ring by itself: OFF it stays at POSITION, 50 is the speed it was recorded at (the ring heard as a loop), 100 four times that.
KNOB4: Scatter individual grain positions around the playhead. Large values explore the ring.
ALGORITHM: Optional automatic generations. It starts OFF and pauses at three full rings, so it never destroys a recording on its own.

KNOB1: Balance between MORPH and SILT's grains. It starts on the grains alone; MORPH is always heard on its own page and while it is captured.
KNOB2: How slowly MORPH's notes come and go.
KNOB3: How far apart MORPH's four voices sit in stereo.
KNOB4: How wide the grains are scattered left to right.
ALGORITHM: How long a struck MORPH note rings before it dies away. At the top (HOLD) notes stay on until their key is tapped again.

KNOB1: Hiss recorded into the next capture. With no notes held it captures noise alone.
KNOB2: The hiss's tone: low rumble to bright hiss.
KNOB3: Reduces the next capture's resolution: grit, then a few hard steps.
KNOB4: Only sound louder than this is captured; quieter stretches become silence.
ALGORITHM: Random gaps in the next capture.

EDIT.label: SILT
EDIT.text: SILT is home. Select a ring, pick LOOP / CLOUD / PULSE / FRACTURE, and increase WEAVE to bring in other recordings. REC captures the processed mix into another generation.

HOME.label: SILT HOME
HOME.text: Returns to SILT from anywhere. It clears nothing.

FX.label: MORPH
FX.text: Opens MORPH, the four-corner synth that makes the sound to capture. The keys are its notes here. REC here captures MORPH into a new ring.

SEL.label: RINGS
SEL.text: Browse three independently recorded rings, lock favorites with KNOB2, or use KNOB4 then SEL to deliberately delete. Selecting never changes a recording.

ENV.label: SHAPE
ENV.text: Opens SILT SHAPE: each grain's envelope and how the grains differ from one another.

LFO.label: MOTION
LFO.text: SILT MOTION: SCAN, irregular TIMING, playhead speed LOOP, SPRAY and optional automatic DRIFT. DRIFT starts OFF.

GLO.label: GUIDE
GLO.text: Held down, the screen itself shows what every button does, laid out as the buttons are, with a line for the keys. Let go to return. Nothing else changes while it is held.

REC.label: NEW RING
REC.text: One press captures a new ring from MORPH or processed SILT. With three rings full it may replace the oldest unlocked, unselected ring; if none are eligible, it refuses. DRIFT never replaces full rings.

PLAY.label: GRAINS
PLAY.text: Starts and stops the continuous stream of grains. Keys still play grains by hand while it is stopped.

OCT-.label: KEYS DOWN
OCT-.text: Shifts the keys down an octave. Notes and pitches already held stay where they are.

OCT+.label: KEYS UP
OCT+.text: Shifts the keys up an octave. Notes and pitches already held stay where they are.

SAVE.unused: SAVE is not available: there is no saving yet, and the rings are lost at power-off.

ARP.label: MIX
ARP.text: Opens MIX: the balance of MORPH and SILT, MORPH's fade and stereo width, the grains' stereo width and the output level.

SEQ.label: REC FX
SEQ.text: Opens REC FX: what the next capture does to the sound it records (noise, crush, gate, dropouts, damping). Rings that exist are never changed.

guide.label: Guide
guide.done: MORPH injects audio. SILT plays three independent recordings with four modes. WEAVE mixes the rings, REC captures a new generation, and RINGS can lock recordings worth preserving.

steps.title: Switch on
steps.text: Press Switch on, on the panel. Sound starts and the screen shows SILT with no rings yet.

steps.title: Touch
steps.text: Tap any key. MORPH strikes a note, the note is caught as RING 01, and the grains start to loop it.

steps.title: Another generation
steps.text: RING 01 plays in SILT. Turn a grain control, then press REC. RING 02 captures the processed sound. DRIFT starts OFF; you can turn it on later under LFO.

steps.title: Rings
steps.text: Press SEL to browse the individual ring recordings. KNOB2 locks/unlocks a favorite. Return to EDIT, use KNOB4 WEAVE to mix rings and ALGORITHM MODE to change how they play.

steps.title: MORPH
steps.text: Press FX. This is MORPH by itself: tap keys, and turn KNOB1 and KNOB2 to move between the four ways of making sound.

steps.title: A new seed
steps.text: Press REC, then tap a key. The note is captured as a new ring, and you are back on SILT with it looping.
